# Claude Allowed Tools - Complete LPZRobots Development Kit
# This includes all tools that are actually useful for LPZRobots development
# Including occasional but important use cases

# Core shells and sudo
Bash(bash:*),Bash(sh:*),Bash(zsh:*),Bash(sudo:*),

# Version control
Bash(git:*),Bash(gh:*),Bash(diff:*),Bash(patch:*),

# File and shell essentials
Bash(ls:*),Bash(cp:*),Bash(mv:*),Bash(rm:*),Bash(mkdir:*),Bash(rmdir:*),Bash(touch:*),Bash(ln:*),Bash(cd:*),Bash(pwd:*),Bash(basename:*),Bash(dirname:*),Bash(realpath:*),Bash(cat:*),Bash(head:*),Bash(tail:*),Bash(less:*),Bash(grep:*),Bash(rg:*),Bash(find:*),Bash(fd:*),Bash(xargs:*),Bash(tee:*),Bash(sort:*),Bash(uniq:*),Bash(cut:*),Bash(paste:*),Bash(tr:*),Bash(printf:*),Bash(echo:*),Bash(file:*),Bash(stat:*),Bash(du:*),Bash(df:*),Bash(wc:*),Bash(tar:*),Bash(gzip:*),Bash(gunzip:*),Bash(zip:*),Bash(unzip:*),Bash(mktemp:*),

# Text processing (important for config files, logs)
Bash(sed:*),Bash(awk:*),

# Build systems (all are used in LPZRobots)
Bash(cmake:*),Bash(make:*),Bash(gmake:*),Bash(ninja:*),Bash(autoconf:*),Bash(automake:*),Bash(autoreconf:*),Bash(libtool:*),Bash(m4:*),Bash(pkg-config:*),Bash(pkgconf:*),Bash(./configure:*),Bash(./bootstrap:*),Bash(./autogen.sh:*),

# LPZRobots specific scripts

# Compilers and binutils

Bash(if:*),Bash(then:*),Bash(else:*),Bash(elif:*),Bash(fi:*),Bash(for:*),Bash(while:*),Bash(do:*),Bash(done:*),Bash(case:*),Bash(esac:*),Bash(function:*),Bash(return:*),Bash(exit:*),Bash(break:*),Bash(continue:*),Bash(shift:*),Bash([[:*),Bash(]]:*),
